signal_rules: patterns on bars with volume >= 0.8x its 20-bar average and no downtrend filter; RSI_OVERSOLD = RSI(14) crossing below 30 on that volume
bearish_rules: bear_patterns: shooting star, hanging man, dark cloud cover, evening star or bearish engulfing on a bar with volume >= 0.8x its 20-bar average and RSI(14) >= 60; RSI_OVERBOUGHT = RSI(14) crossing above 70 on that volume

strength.5: Strong: score >= 11, RSI oversold or bullish engulfing, liquid, price >= 3, not after a 20-bar drop of 25%, not below EMA200, last report not a miss
strength.4: Good: score >= 10, a candle pattern (or RSI oversold on weekly / monthly), liquid

strength_score: 1 point each: drop 5 bars >= 2 ATR, drop 20 bars >= 3 ATR, RSI(2) < 15 / < 10 / < 5, volume >= 1.2x / 1.5x / 2x, volume <= 1x, ADX >= 20 with +DI > -DI, EPS growing y/y, pattern + RSI oversold, no red arrow in 3 bars, S&P 500 member, low within 1 ATR of EMA50 / EMA200, low 20% of the 55-bar channel, trend score 3, RSI(14) <= 35, last report beat

bear_strength.5: score >= 0, RSI overbought or bearish engulfing, liquid, not after a 20-bar rise of 25%, below EMA200, last report not a beat
bear_strength.4: score >= 9, a bearish candle pattern, liquid

bear_strength_score: the mirror of strength_score (rise, RSI(2) > 85 / 90 / 95, -DI > +DI, EPS falling, ...)
